BiblicalUsage: The word is a basket, woven of osiers. Israel was to take the first of all the fruit of the land and put it in a basket, and go to the place the Lord chose; the priest would take the basket out of the hand and set it down before the altar; and the blessing says, Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the basket of firstfruits is the sign of a harvest given back to God, and the blessing follows it.
